trust_compliance.research_use_only_phrasing: Bachem expressly draws attention to the fact that, unless otherwise labeled, Bachem products are intended exclusively for laboratory and research purposes.
trust_compliance.jurisdictional_restriction_notice: Bachem expressly forbids the distribution of dangerous substances to private individuals.
trust_compliance.tos_highlights: Multi-currency pricing in CHF, USD, or EUR exclusive of VAT; Net-30 invoice payment terms with 1.25% monthly overdue surcharge; reservation-of-title until full payment received; warranty limited to lot conformity per analytical result document with 8-day defect notice; products restricted to public research, experimental and teaching institutes, technical facilities and pertinent industrial enterprises with private-individual distribution expressly forbidden; APIs only sold to patent holders or under Bolar/35 U.S.C. § 271(e)(1) exempted uses; Swiss law and Basel-Stadt courts as exclusive venue for Swiss-Group entities; buyer indemnifies Bachem against claims relating to import/export/regulatory activities.
trust_compliance.refund_policy: Bachem shall at Bachem's discretion either (i) replace defective products or (ii) refund product price to Buyer (TOS §6.4); defects must be notified in writing within 8 days of delivery with proof of non-conformity (lot, order, invoice number) or product is deemed accepted (TOS §6.2).
trust_compliance.shipping_policy: Delivery terms vary by country and follow agreed Incoterms® (TOS §4.1); transport, freight, data logger and handling charges payable separately by Buyer (TOS §2.4); Bachem may apply surcharges for small-quantity deliveries or special shipment conditions like ice or dry ice (TOS §2.3); no liability for delayed delivery (TOS §4.2).

payment_methods_accepted: bank wire (per TOS 9.1: 'Buyer shall pay the purchase price as stated in the order confirmation only to the bank account named in the order confirmation')
checkout_flow.shipping_cost_structure: Negotiated per Incoterms; transport/freight/data-logger/handling charges added separately; small-quantity surcharges may apply; cold-chain (ice / dry ice) surcharges may apply.
checkout_flow.international_policy: Bachem ships internationally directly or via reputable specialized distributors per the shop.bachem.com 'Catalog Distributor Locations' note; ~75 countries are listed in the shop's country selector covering North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Africa and Latin America.

uncertainty_notes: FIELDS LEGITIMATELY UNCERTAIN BECAUSE OF B2B-INSTITUTIONAL POSTURE (not fetch failures): catalog.sku_count — Bachem advertises 'thousands of different biologically active peptides' (shop_homepage.md) but does not publish an aggregate count and the catalog page renders Divi/ACF templates rather than a paginated listing the curl pipeline can count; product_page_anatomy.photographic_treatment — the html2text rendering does not preserve images and the catalog uses chemical-structure thumbnails plus brand iconography rather than a single photographic treatment that can be characterized verbatim; checkout_flow.account_required, guest_checkout_available, fields_collected, fields_collected[0], id_verification_present, shipping_carriers, shipping_carriers[0] — the public /cart/ endpoint renders an empty cart page without exposing the checkout fields; the catalog uses a YITH 'Request a Quote / Inquiry List' flow (yith-woocommerce-request-a-quote-premium plugin observed in source_product.md) plus add-to-cart for some pack sizes, but final checkout fields are gated behind the cart having items in it (directive §11 forbids adding fake test items / fake KYC submissions). content_footprint.content_cadence — three press-release URLs were fetched but a complete 12-month timeline scan was not performed and individual post timestamps are not exposed in html2text output. social_proof.off_site_aggregators, off_site_aggregators[0] — no Trustpilot / G2 / niche aggregator was probed in this pass; institutional vendors typically rely on RFQ relationships rather than retail review aggregators. PRICING-SPECIFIC: list_price_usd AND per_mg_price_usd for SKUs 2 (Semaglutide, skus[3]), 4 ((D-Lys³)-GHRP-6, skus[6]), 5 (modified Liraglutide, skus[7]) are 'uncertain' because the Bachem shop uses the woocommerce-price-based-country-pro-addon plugin (observed in source_product.md plugin list) which renders prices in EUR (Semaglutide), CHF ((D-Lys³)-GHRP-6 and Liraglutide-modified), or USD (Pal-GHK, Thymosin β₄, His-Lys, Ala-His-Lys) depending on the buyer's geo-IP at fetch time — the displayed currency was not USD for those SKUs and forex conversion was not performed (rule 1: no fabrication). The fetched prices are: Semaglutide 1mg €304.20; (D-Lys³)-GHRP-6 5mg CHF 78.10 / 25mg CHF 314.60; modified Liraglutide 1mg €495.73 / 5mg €1,735.11 / 10mg €2,949.45 — these are documented verbatim in the evidence file under their respective claims as native-currency captures, not converted to USD. lab_partner_named is documented as 'Bachem in-house' because Bachem hosts its own Analytical Data Sheet portal at ads-pub.bachem.com (visible in the ACF dump on product_3__thymosin-b4-4043020.md line 988) rather than using a third-party COA host like Janoshik. coa_present='true' relies on the in-vendor ADS Lookup at https://www.bachem.com/knowledge-center/analytical-data-sheet-ads/ rather than a public per-SKU PDF link; this is a per-batch ADS retrievable by product number, classified as on_site COA hosting. customer_review_module_present='false' and related_product_modules_present='false' both verified by absence of any 'review', 'rated', 'related products', 'customers also bought' patterns in product_3__thymosin-b4-4043020.md (grep returned zero hits). age_gate_present='false' verified by absence of any age confirmation modal in homepage.md or shop_homepage.md — Bachem instead restricts via TOS §7.2 'distribution of dangerous substances to private individuals' is 'expressly forbidden', i.e. KYC at the corporate-buyer level rather than an age-gate. crypto_discount_pct=0 and subscription_price_usd=null reflect that Bachem uses bank wire / order-confirmation invoice (TOS §9.1) and does not offer crypto discounts or auto-ship subscriptions — these are retail patterns absent on this institutional CDMO. peptide_canonical='other' for the H-His-Lys-OH · HBr and H-Ala-His-Lys-OH SKUs because they are dipeptide / tripeptide fragments / analogs, not entries in the directive §2.3 named-peptide list.
